items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I have never known him to work with anyone, but he's always worked as a single.

ctx.x: Another person that was here and working as a single was Harold Brown. Now, Harold Brown, he has worked in some very fine spots in Los Angeles, as a single. He's never -- I have never known him to work with anyone, but he's always worked as a single.
Lawrence Brown's brother. And to my knowledge he probably gets on a job and stays on it longer than anybody.
